exam_scheme.note: Telangana State Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (TG EAPCET, formerly TS EAMCET) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH) on behalf of the Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE). For the Engineering stream (MPC), the test comprises 160 multiple-choice questions (80 Mathematics, 40 Physics, 40 Chemistry) of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration. Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. The qualifying mark is 25% of the maximum marks (40 out of 160) for General and BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for SC and ST candidates. Ranks are assigned purely on the basis of normalized marks scored in the Computer Based Test.
